image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of the head and upper jaw of a Nile crocodile. The mouth is slightly open, revealing interlocking conical teeth. The skin texture is highly detailed, showing rough, bony scutes on the snout and smoother scales on the lower jaw. The eye is visible with a vertical slit pupil. The background is blurred, focusing entirely on the reptile's head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers to a point, consistent with the V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator. The head structure appears broad and robust.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image shows an open mouth with clearly defined, sharp, conical teeth. The fourth tooth on the lower jaw appears prominent, fitting the interlocking description. Note: The prompt says 'visible when mouth is closed', but the image shows it open; however, the teeth morphology is correct for the class.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is positioned high on the skull (dorsal). The pupil is a distinct vertical slit. The nictitating membrane is not clearly deployed/visible in this specific frame, but the eye structure is anatomically correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The angle of the photo cuts off the very tip of the snout where the nostrils would be located. They are outside the frame or obscured by the perspective.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the head and neck are visible. The full body length cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin on the top of the snout and behind the eye shows heavy, irregular, bony texturing consistent with osteoderms/scutes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of greys and browns, and the texture is visibly rough and granular.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside of the jaw (visible inside the mouth line and on the lower jaw exterior) shows smoother, lighter-colored scaling compared to the dorsal side.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Limbs are completely out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.

artifact_observations.location: Lower left corner, near the jaw hinge/neck area
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a slight softness/blurring in the transition between the crocodile's neck and the foreground/background element (possibly a hand or rock). It lacks the crisp micro-texture seen on the snout, suggesting potential inpainting or depth-of-field artifacting common in AI generation.

While mostly accurate, one or two teeth on the lower jaw seem to emerge from the gum line at slightly inconsistent angles, lacking the perfect uniform root embedding seen in high-end macro photography. This is subtle but noticeable upon close inspection.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the teeth. AI often struggles with the precise interlocking mechanism of crocodile teeth. Check if the fourth lower tooth actually fits into the upper jaw notch if visible, or if the teeth look like they are just pasted on the surface. Also, verify the eye reflection; real eyes have complex specular highlights, while AI eyes can look glassy or flat.
